To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have presented new formulae for CDF of McKay-Bessel distribution which are valid for all parameters and for which the formula of Nadarajah et al. (2007) is not applicable.

we have obtained new formulae for the cumulative distribution function for the McKay Bessel distribution, and we have also obtained new series formulae in terms of the Kampé de Fèriet function and Marcum’s Q-function.
new formulae for CDF of McKay–Bessel distribution have been obtained.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the derivation of several computational series formula for the cumulative distribution function of the McKay Bessell function distribution.

the development of new formulae and computational formulae for the cumulative distribution function for the McKay Bessel distribution, which are more accurate than existing formulae and can be calculated by inbuilt routines.
new formulae for CDF for McKay Bessel function and its special cases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
all the new formulae are more efficient and convenient to use than the Nadarajah Srivastava Gupta (2007).

the CDF of the McKay Bessels distribution is given by a single formula which can be evaluated in closed-form in terms of Horn confluent hyper-geometric function, Marcum Q-function, incomplete Gamma function γ, and Exton's double hypergeometric function X–function.
the new results are useful and interesting for applications and for further research.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we present new formulae which are more convenient for the numerical computation of the CDF for McKay Bessel function and also for certain values of the parameters for which Nadarajah Srivastava Gupta’s formula fails to be computed by in-built numerical software.
we have presented new formulae for the cumulative distribution function of the McKay Besselfunction distribution.
the CDF of the McKay Bessell distribution has a very wide range of representations and can be expressed in terms of a number of special functions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we provide a new formula for the CDF FK for the McKay Bessel distribution containing the Marcum Q-function.
the new formulae for CDF of McKay distribution can be easily computed by in-built numerical routine.

the new formulae for CDF FK for the McKay Bessel distribution can be used to compute the CDF for the distribution when parameters of the distribution are such that the in-built numerical routine fails to calculate the CDF.
